selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: curl changed from the normal install selection to hold. Upgrade simulations before and after reboot retained version 7.16.4-2ubuntu1.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel

selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot ID was 72ac741f-1ec3-49fe-8369-e2ff05c857dc; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID was 7e1f3a32-9c17-41f1-ad6e-e469135b51f7. curl recovered functional and held at the required version.
